title: Rankings of Online Travel Agents, Channel Pricing, and Consumer Protection
authors: Matthias Hunold; Reinhold Kesler; Ulrich Laitenberger
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Main regressions (analyses_booking.do, analyses_expedia.do) regress a hotel's position in the OTA search list (rev_list) on continuous price differences to other channels (direct_spanne, expedia_spanne / booking_spanne, and binned or absolute variants) with hotel FE, month dummies and time-varying controls (price, promo, rating, occupancy, Google Trends); additional regressions model the probability that another channel is cheaper with city FE, and a rank-ordered logit. The research question is OTA ranking responses to channel price differences, not a staggered policy adoption.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe (hotel FE bookingid/expediaid), rologit. Scraped Booking.com, Expedia and Kayak search results plus Google Trends.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: continuous price-difference regressors with time-varying controls; not a DiD
cross-sectional probability models with city FE
